SUPERSEDES.REASON: Independent reproducibility review found deterministic primary-omission identity, final-DOC-C coverage proof, primary-omission reference-shape, and reconciliation reference-shape gaps.

PRIMARY_SPEC.LOGICAL_FILENAME: แอป [NEXY-IGNIS] ที่กำลังพัฒนา.docx

MATRIX_EXPORT.FORMAT: UTF-8 parsed-text export containing CSV sheets

PARAGRAPH_INDEX_CONTRACT.AUTHORITY_COMPARISON_RULE: All temporal/authority comparisons use transformed one-based primary DOCX paragraph numbers, never raw matrix paragraph numbers.

NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.CSV_PARSER: RFC4180-compatible quoting for comma-separated rows; doubled quote escapes; quoted commas/newlines preserved
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.BUILD_MATRIX_EXTRACTION: Read only the first sheet named Build Matrix from MATRIX_EXPORT, from its exact header through the row before the next <PARSED TEXT FOR SHEET marker.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.STRING_RULE: Decode CSV cell, normalize Unicode NFC, preserve non-empty content exactly including leading/trailing whitespace; do not semantic-trim.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.EMPTY_CELL_RULE: An empty decoded CSV cell becomes JSON null. Nullable fields are always present with null; keys are never omitted.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.INTEGER_RULE: index, Source_Doc_Paragraph and Source_Extraction_Seq are base-10 JSON integers; non-integer or missing values are invalid.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.BOOLEAN_RULE: Schema booleans are JSON true/false only.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.SET_ARRAY_RULE: Set-like arrays are deduplicated then sorted by UTF-8 byte ordering of their canonical string representation.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.REFERENCE_ARRAY_RULE: Primary-source reference arrays sort by paragraph_1_based ascending, then anchor UTF-8 bytes.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.ENTRY_SORT_RULE: Root entries sort by source_entry_id UTF-8 bytes; duplicate source_entry_id is invalid.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.JCS_RULE: Apply RFC8785/JCS only after this normalization contract.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.SELF_REFERENCE_RULE: ROOT_HASH is stored outside ROOT_OBJECT and never hashed into itself.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.PRIMARY_SPAN_REFERENCE_ARRAY_RULE: PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1 arrays sort by paragraph_1_based, start_utf8_byte_offset, end_utf8_byte_offset_exclusive, anchor null-first/UTF-8; exact duplicates are removed before sorting.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.PARAGRAPH_REFERENCE_ARRAY_RULE: DOCX_PARAGRAPH_REF_V1 arrays sort by paragraph_1_based then anchor null-first/UTF-8; exact duplicates are removed before sorting.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.EVIDENCE_REFERENCE_ARRAY_RULE: ARTIFACT_EVIDENCE_REF_V1 arrays sort by artifact_path UTF-8, git_blob_sha, locator null-first/UTF-8; exact duplicates are removed before sorting.

SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Exhaustive normalized source-material identity; never the active-build denominator.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.MATRIX_ROW_INCLUSION: All 837 Build Matrix rows must appear exactly once.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.PRIMARY_OMISSION_RULE: Any normative final DOC-C obligation not represented by a matrix row must be normalized as PRIMARY_FINAL_DOC_C_OMISSION before this root can be activation-ready.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.COVERAGE_GATE: primary_final_doc_c_coverage_unmatched_count MUST be mechanically copied from the bound coverage root unmatched_normative_obligation_count and MUST equal 0; disagreement is invalid.
FORBIDDEN_SHORTCUTS: 837 structurally valid matrix rows do not prove exhaustive final DOC-C coverage when known primary omissions exist.
Do not treat workbook declared SHA256 as the byte hash of MATRIX_EXPORT.
Do not use source enumeration as active-build authority or implementation proof.

PRIMARY_OMISSION_TYPE_CONTRACT.primary_obligation_id: string present in the bound FINAL_DOC_C_COVERAGE_ROOT_HASH with classification PRIMARY_OMISSION_REQUIRED
PRIMARY_OMISSION_TYPE_CONTRACT.requirement: nonempty Unicode-NFC human-readable obligation text represented by the bound spans
PRIMARY_OMISSION_TYPE_CONTRACT.primary_docx_refs_1_based: nonempty canonical array of PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1 exactly equal to coverage entry primary_span_refs

SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.PRIMARY_OMISSION_ID_RULE: source_entry_id MUST equal 'DOC-C-OMISSION:' + primary_obligation_id. Random UUIDs, discovery ordinals, task IDs, reviewer IDs, timestamps, and mutable array indexes are forbidden.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.COVERAGE_BINDING_RULE: final_doc_c_coverage_root_hash MUST bind a coverage root with the same spec_artifact_hash and unmatched_normative_obligation_count == 0. Every PRIMARY_OMISSION_REQUIRED coverage entry maps to exactly one deterministic PRIMARY_FINAL_DOC_C_OMISSION source entry.

AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Complete authority decision manifest covering every source-enumeration entry exactly once.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.ACTIVE_AUTHORITY_RULE: Every ACTIVE decision MUST contain at least one final_doc_c_normative_refs_1_based reference within primary paragraphs 9886..10499. Document class labels alone never confer build authority.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.NEGATIVE_OBLIGATION_RULE: Final DOC-C MUST_NOT/non-goal requirements are ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_NEGATIVE with polarity PROHIBIT and remain in the active-build denominator.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.DOC_B_RULE: DOC-B may constrain interpretation but cannot independently create an active-build obligation without a final DOC-C normative incorporation reference.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.DOC_D_RULE: DOC-D may provide supporting design detail but cannot independently create an active-build obligation; active use requires explicit final DOC-C normative incorporation.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.HISTORICAL_RULE: Pre-FINAL historical rows cannot become ACTIVE without explicit final DOC-C normative incorporation evidence.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.COMPLETENESS_RULE: entry_count MUST equal SOURCE_ENUMERATION entry_count, source_entry_id sets MUST be identical, and unresolved_count MUST equal count(CONFLICT|UNKNOWN).

REFERENCE_TYPE_CONTRACT.final_doc_c_normative_refs_1_based: canonical array of PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1; nonempty for ACTIVE decisions, empty allowed otherwise
REFERENCE_TYPE_CONTRACT.supporting_doc_b_refs_1_based: canonical array of DOCX_PARAGRAPH_REF_V1; empty allowed
REFERENCE_TYPE_CONTRACT.supporting_doc_d_refs_1_based: canonical array of DOCX_PARAGRAPH_REF_V1; empty allowed
REFERENCE_TYPE_CONTRACT.deployment_doc_e_refs_1_based: canonical array of DOCX_PARAGRAPH_REF_V1; empty allowed

AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.REFERENCE_EMPTY_RULE: Reference arrays are always present. Empty arrays use [] and never null. authority_evidence_refs is never empty.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.REFERENCE_ORDER_RULE: Each reference array is independently deduplicated and sorted according to its canonical schema before JCS.

ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Stable immutable denominator of current positive and negative build obligations.

ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.supporting_refs: canonical array of SUPPORTING_DOC_REF_V1; empty array allowed
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.dependencies_identity: array of source_entry_id strings; empty array allowed
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.validation_acceptance_criteria: array of immutable acceptance-criterion strings; nonempty

ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.INCLUSION_RULE: Include exactly reconciliation entries with ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_POSITIVE or ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_NEGATIVE.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.AUTHORITY_RULE: Each entry must retain the same final DOC-C normative refs and polarity proven by the bound reconciliation root.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.STABILITY_RULE: Mutable implementation/accounting states are forbidden from this denominator root.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.MUTABLE_ACCOUNTING_LOCATION: Requirement accounting is maintained in separate versioned ledgers/evidence and is evaluated against this stable denominator during closure.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.MUST_NOT_VERIFICATION_RULE: PROHIBIT obligations require positive evidence that forbidden capability/behavior is absent or unreachable; omission from implementation is not self-proving.
FORBIDDEN_SHORTCUTS: Do not include DOC-B, DOC-D, supplements, or historical rows solely from their source labels.
Do not omit final DOC-C negative obligations.
Do not materialize if bound reconciliation unresolved_count is nonzero.
Do not use the legacy current-ish aggregate of 773 rows as this denominator.

DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.PURPOSE: Stable denominator of DOC-E deployment/runtime proof obligations, separate from implementation.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.INCLUSION_RULE: Include exactly reconciliation entries classified DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_ONLY with valid DOC-E primary refs.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.SEPARATION_RULE: Deployment evidence cannot satisfy, replace, or increase ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT obligations.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.STABILITY_RULE: Mutable evidence status is forbidden from this denominator root and is tracked separately.

ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.validation_acceptance_criteria: nonempty canonical array of immutable Unicode-NFC strings

CURRENT_MATRIX_SCOPE_COUNTS.LEGACY_CURRENT_ISH_AGGREGATE_773: 12 + 547 + 127 + 87; this is not the literal CURRENT_BUILD count and is not an authority denominator.

GLOBAL_VALIDATION_GATES: A FINAL_DOC_C_COVERAGE root conforming to V3 must independently verify complete pinned final-DOC-C normative coverage.
Every PRIMARY_OMISSION_REQUIRED coverage entry must have exactly one deterministic PRIMARY_FINAL_DOC_C_OMISSION source entry whose source_entry_id equals 'DOC-C-OMISSION:' + primary_obligation_id.
Source enumeration must bind the exact final-DOC-C coverage root and have zero unmatched.
Source enumeration and reconciliation source_entry_id sets must be identical.
Every active-build entry must bind final DOC-C normative authority through canonical PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1 references.
Every final DOC-C MUST_NOT/non-goal is represented as a PROHIBIT obligation.
All reconciliation reference arrays conform to exact canonical object schemas, empty/null rules, deduplication and ordering.
No mutable accounting/evidence status appears in denominator roots.
All root objects pass normalization and independent JCS/SHA-256 recomputation.

PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1.RANGE_RULE: paragraph_1_based MUST be within FINAL_DOC_C_PRIMARY_RANGE_1_BASED for final-DOC-C authority/coverage use.
PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1.OFFSET_RULE: Offsets index UTF-8 bytes of the Unicode-NFC paragraph text extracted from the pinned SPEC_ARTIFACT_HASH; slice boundaries MUST be valid UTF-8 code-point boundaries.
PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1.SORT_RULE: paragraph_1_based ascending, start_utf8_byte_offset ascending, end_utf8_byte_offset_exclusive ascending, anchor null first then UTF-8 bytes.
PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1.DUPLICATE_RULE: Exact duplicate objects are deduplicated before sorting.
PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1.KEY_PRESENCE_RULE: All EXACT_KEYS are always present; anchor uses JSON null when unavailable.

DOCX_PARAGRAPH_REF_V1.SORT_RULE: paragraph_1_based ascending, anchor null first then UTF-8 bytes.
DOCX_PARAGRAPH_REF_V1.DUPLICATE_RULE: Exact duplicate objects are deduplicated before sorting.
DOCX_PARAGRAPH_REF_V1.KEY_PRESENCE_RULE: Both keys are always present; anchor uses JSON null when unavailable.

ARTIFACT_EVIDENCE_REF_V1.SORT_RULE: artifact_path UTF-8 bytes, git_blob_sha bytes, locator null first then UTF-8 bytes.
ARTIFACT_EVIDENCE_REF_V1.DUPLICATE_RULE: Exact duplicate objects are deduplicated before sorting.
ARTIFACT_EVIDENCE_REF_V1.KEY_PRESENCE_RULE: All keys are always present; locator uses JSON null when no finer locator exists.

SUPPORTING_DOC_REF_V1.SORT_RULE: document_class UTF-8 bytes, paragraph_1_based ascending, anchor null first then UTF-8 bytes.
SUPPORTING_DOC_REF_V1.DUPLICATE_RULE: Exact duplicate objects are deduplicated before sorting.

PRIMARY_OBLIGATION_ID_CONTRACT.IDENTITY_OBJECT_RULE: domain is fixed IDENTITY_OBJECT_DOMAIN; spec_artifact_hash equals pinned SPEC_ARTIFACT_HASH; primary_span_refs is canonical sorted nonempty PRIMARY_SPAN_REF_V1; normative_text_sha256 is SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 bytes obtained by slicing each referenced NFC paragraph by byte offsets and concatenating slices in canonical span order with one LF byte between slices.
PRIMARY_OBLIGATION_ID_CONTRACT.COLLISION_RULE: If one derived primary_obligation_id maps to two non-byte-identical JCS identity objects, set coverage state BLOCKED_CRYPTOGRAPHIC_ID_COLLISION and materialize no requirement roots.
PRIMARY_OBLIGATION_ID_CONTRACT.SPLIT_RULE: Splitting a prior obligation requires new span sets and therefore new primary_obligation_id values; the prior ID MUST NOT be reused.
PRIMARY_OBLIGATION_ID_CONTRACT.MERGE_RULE: Merging prior obligations requires a new canonical span set and therefore a new primary_obligation_id; prior IDs MUST NOT be reused.
PRIMARY_OBLIGATION_ID_CONTRACT.TEXT_CHANGE_RULE: Any normative text byte change under a newly pinned Spec changes normative_text_sha256 and therefore primary_obligation_id.
PRIMARY_OBLIGATION_ID_CONTRACT.NO_POSITIONAL_ORDINAL_RULE: Identity MUST NOT depend on mutable manifest array index, reviewer order, task order, or discovery time.

FINAL_DOC_C_COVERAGE_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Hash-bound canonical denominator of final DOC-C normative obligations used to prove complete primary coverage before source enumeration.

ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.mapped_matrix_source_entry_ids: array of matrix source_entry_id strings; empty allowed only when classification is not MATRIX_REPRESENTED
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.primary_omission_source_entry_id: string|null; non-null exactly when classification is PRIMARY_OMISSION_REQUIRED
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.non_obligation_reason: string|null; non-null exactly when classification is NON_OBLIGATION

CLASSIFICATION_RULES: MATRIX_REPRESENTED requires mapped_matrix_source_entry_ids length >= 1, primary_omission_source_entry_id == null, and non_obligation_reason == null.
PRIMARY_OMISSION_REQUIRED requires mapped_matrix_source_entry_ids length == 0, primary_omission_source_entry_id == ('DOC-C-OMISSION:' + primary_obligation_id), and non_obligation_reason == null.
NON_OBLIGATION requires mapped_matrix_source_entry_ids length == 0, primary_omission_source_entry_id == null, and non_obligation_reason be a nonempty immutable justification string.

A normative obligation is unmatched when classification is MATRIX_REPRESENTED but mapped matrix IDs are missing/invalid, or classification is PRIMARY_OMISSION_REQUIRED but the required omission ID is missing/invalid.
unmatched_normative_obligation_count is mechanically derived from entries and MUST NOT be independently asserted.
FINAL_DOC_C_COVERAGE_ROOT_HASH.COVERAGE_COMPLETENESS_RULE: The manifest MUST exhaustively classify final DOC-C primary normative material represented by the pinned FINAL_DOC_C_PRIMARY_INDEX. Completeness requires independent review of span coverage and classification; unknown or disputed material is blocking and cannot be silently classified NON_OBLIGATION.
FINAL_DOC_C_COVERAGE_ROOT_HASH.ENTRY_SORT_RULE: entries sort by primary_obligation_id UTF-8 bytes; duplicate primary_obligation_id is invalid.
FINAL_DOC_C_COVERAGE_ROOT_HASH.ACTIVATION_GATE: unmatched_normative_obligation_count MUST equal 0 and no coverage review conflict/unknown may remain.
